the synthesis of α nucleosides from uracils and the 2,3-unsaturated uracils, the synthesis of the α nucleosides by the use of uracils and 2,3-un-saturated uracils and their derivatives.

the silylated uracils react in the presence of TMS triflate with methyl 2.3,5-tris-O-benzoylarabinofuranosides 3 to form a mixture of the N1,N3-glycoside (N-glycoside) 6 and the N3-glycoide (N-glucoide) 8.
the reaction of 6-ethylthiouridine with 3 gave 12 as the major product.
the reaction of 5 with 3 in the presence of TMS triflate gave 6 and 10, which were deprotected by treatment with aqueous ammonia and aqueous methanolic ammonia, respectively, to give 7, 9, and 12.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the reaction of silyated uracils with silylated arabinofuranosides in the presence of TMS triflate afforded the corresponding N3-glycose derivatives.

silylated 5-substituted uridines react with 3 to give the corresponding N1,N3-α-arabinosyluracil derivatives 6, while 6-substituents favor the formation of 6-substitued 2,3-5-tri-O-protected α-arabinosyl-uracils 9.
